The Al0.4 alloy shows a single-phase FCC diffraction peak structure in the as-cast state, and the crystal plane index is (111), (200), (220), (311), (222).

The addition of ceramic phase TiC does not alter the phase structure of the alloy matrix. Apart from the FCC matrix phase, it was observed that an additional ceramic phase TiC, exhibiting the same FCC crystal structure, is present with crystal plane indices of (111) and (200).
